title: Governed Fallback Semantics
content:
Governed Fallback Semantics Status: Implemented (planning data model) . Fallback behavior is represented explicitly as operator-visible planning records and is not silently executed
Each fallback record includes origin candidate, fallback target, reason, policy/degraded status, and operator explanation
